name: Card
description: A flexible, composable card component system for creating consistent card-style UI elements. The root Card can function as a clickable link or a static container. Includes sub-components for content, media, and titles.
usage: Use the `href` prop to render the Card as a Next.js Link. Omit `href` to render as a static container (previously called CardWrapper).
Compose with CardContent, CardMedia, and CardTitle for structured content.
Use the static variant (no href) for non-clickable card-like containers.
Control inner padding with the `padding` prop on CardContent ('none', 'sm', 'md', 'lg').
examples:
```tsx
// Linking Card
<Card href="/articles/my-article">
  <CardMedia>
    <Image src="/images/article.jpg" alt="Article" fill />
  </CardMedia>
  <CardContent>
    <CardTitle title="My Article" subtitle="Published January 1, 2024" />
  </CardContent>
</Card>
```

design: Uses Tailwind CSS with CSS variables for theming.
Hover state (Linking Card Only): Transitions to `var(--color-surface-section)` background and shadow reduces.
Text color: Uses standard text tokens.
Override shadow or background via `className` if needed.
accessibility: Linking Card uses Next.js Link for navigation.
Focus and hover states are visually indicated.
Static cards do not have hover effects by default.
Ensure interactive content inside Card is accessible via keyboard if needed.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content, typically composed of CardContent, CardMedia, and CardTitle.

props.name: href
props.description: If provided, the Card renders as a Next.js Link with link-specific hover styles. Omit for static card.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element (Link or div).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Optional click handler. Applied to the root Link or div.

subcomponents.name: CardContent
subcomponents.description: Container for card text/content with consistent padding and styling.

subcomponents.name: CardMedia
subcomponents.description: Container for media content with configurable aspect ratio.

subcomponents.name: CardTitle
subcomponents.description: Standard component for displaying card titles and subtitles.
